summary: Retain one active Pocahontas Parkway concession, correct the canonical operating and holding-company identities, record Globalvia's directly disclosed 68.14% current stake from its December 20, 2016 close, and retain Northleaf as a current direct co-investor from 2017. Northleaf's 31.86% figure is a residual inference and must remain qualified rather than becoming an exact structured stake. Preserve the predecessor ownership chain and exclude concession components and debt counterparties.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Northleaf's exact fund, upstream SPV and 2017 entry date are not publicly disclosed.
Northleaf's 31.86% and Centerbridge's historical 25.5% figures are inferred residuals rather than directly disclosed stakes.
The full 2014 lender allocation and exact Pocahontas Parkway Holdings-to-Operations entity chain are not publicly disclosed.
recommendedActions: Retain one canonical toll-road concession and use Pocahontas Parkway Operations, LLC as the operating identity with Pocahontas Parkway Holdings, LLC as its parent.
Record Globalvia as an active 68.14% owner from December 20, 2016.
Retain Northleaf as an active direct co-investor from 2017 without converting the inferred 31.86% residual into an exact structured stake.
Preserve the Transurban, CP2, lender, Macquarie, CPP Investments and Centerbridge ownership history with inference labels where required.
Exclude the Richmond Airport Connector, road components, VDOT, TIFIA, Allianz and other debt or operating counterparties from separate direct-equity records.
